name: red-timeline
purpose: X001 RED: behavioral specification of the timeline model run against the naive first attempt (evidence/red/timeline.stub.cjs, which re-runs the producer, folds with its own formula, clamps positions, interpolates gaps and refuses nothing). Must exit 1 on assertion failures.

notOk: stateAt(i) is the C044 reducer folded over entries 0..i for every position of every console run
a position outside the recording is typed NOT_RECORDED and carries no state, never the nearest one
replayed duplicates are counted and marked DUPLICATE, never applied as new events
a true gap names its exact skipped range and nothing inside it is interpolated
a restart is an epoch change with its position and each epoch keeps its own recorded window
a recording that stops before the producer total is INCOMPLETE and shows recorded of total
failed entries are FAILED and unknown events or entry types are UNKNOWN, never success-shaped
the accepted C034 traces fold with their own outcomes and hostile ones are refused with the decoder code
a malformed saved run is refused with a typed code
jumps land exactly on the next or previous gap, failure, unknown or epoch change
building and scrubbing re-executes nothing: no producer, timer or network is started
verify recomputes every position from the raw entries and detects a forged state
a fragment is parsed strictly and a hostile one is a typed refusal that echoes nothing
